hero.answer: Claude cannot reach a Hostpoint mailbox on its own. MCPEmails is a hosted MCP server that connects it over IMAP at imap.mail.hostpoint.ch on port 993, signing in with the full address and the mailbox password, so Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can read, search, send and organize the mail. Hostpoint's settings page lists exactly these hosts: imap.mail.hostpoint.ch on 993 with SSL and asmtp.mail.hostpoint.ch on 465 with SSL (587 with STARTTLS as the alternative), with SMTP authentication switched on and the password you set in the Control Panel. There is no app password and nothing to enable. One inbox is free, forever.

method.title: How Hostpoint connects: imap.mail.hostpoint.ch on 993, asmtp on 465
method.body: Hostpoint publishes one pair of hosts for every mailbox it hosts. The incoming server is imap.mail.hostpoint.ch on port 993 with SSL, or 143 with STARTTLS, and the outgoing server is asmtp.mail.hostpoint.ch on port 465 with SSL, or 587 with STARTTLS, with SMTP authentication that Hostpoint says must be activated. The username is your e-mail address and the password is the one you defined in the Control Panel; Hostpoint names the login mechanisms as CLEAR TEXT for IMAP and PLAIN for SMTP, which is the same PLAIN mechanism the server advertises. Both hosts answered a live TLS connection under a certificate for *.mail.hostpoint.ch: a Dovecot banner on IMAP and an Exim greeting on SMTP with a 50 MB message limit. One historical note from Hostpoint's page: mailboxes created before 1 June 2014 need the IMAP path prefix set to INBOX in some mail programs; newer ones need nothing.

setup.p: Sign up at mcpemails.com. The free plan connects one mailbox, forever, and does not ask for a card.

setup.h: Find or set the mailbox password in the Hostpoint Control Panel
setup.p: Sign in to the Hostpoint Control Panel and open the e-mail section for the domain. Each address has its own password there, the one Hostpoint's settings page calls the password you defined in the Control Panel. If you do not know it, set a new one for that mailbox; your Hostpoint customer login is a different credential and is refused by IMAP.

setup.h: Enter the address and the password in MCPEmails
setup.p: Choose IMAP / SMTP and enter the full address, such as info@ihre-firma.ch, with the mailbox password. The hosts imap.mail.hostpoint.ch and asmtp.mail.hostpoint.ch are prefilled with 993 and 465, both SSL, and were verified from a live TLS connection.

setup.h: Paste the MCP URL into your AI
setup.p: Drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the mailbox.

gotchas.h: The outgoing host is asmtp, not smtp
gotchas.p: Hostpoint's sending host is asmtp.mail.hostpoint.ch, the a standing for authenticated. A client configured with smtp.mail.hostpoint.ch by habit is pointing at a name Hostpoint does not document for sending. MCPEmails prefills the asmtp name, and SMTP authentication is always on, which is the setting Hostpoint says must be activated.

gotchas.h: PLAIN only on IMAP, and no MOVE
gotchas.p: The Dovecot behind imap.mail.hostpoint.ch advertises AUTH=PLAIN alone on IMAP, while SMTP accepts PLAIN and LOGIN. Tooling hard-wired to the LOGIN mechanism gets a refusal at the authentication step on IMAP; MCPEmails uses PLAIN. The pre-login capability list has no MOVE, UIDPLUS or SPECIAL-USE, so filing a message runs as a copy, a flag update and an expunge, and the sent, drafts and trash folders are matched by their names. On a German-language mailbox that often means Gesendet, Entwürfe and Papierkorb; name the folder in your instruction if the agent cannot find it.

gotchas.h: Mailboxes from before June 2014 may hide their folders under INBOX
gotchas.p: Hostpoint's page says that accounts created before 1 June 2014 need special IMAP settings: the IMAP path prefix set to INBOX, with or without a trailing period depending on the program. On such a mailbox the folders appear under INBOX rather than beside it. MCPEmails lists folders by the names the server returns, so an agent still finds them; if a folder seems missing, ask for it by its full path.

limits: The SMTP server announces a maximum message size of 50 MB. A forward carrying larger attachments is refused at send time.
Because the server does not advertise MOVE, a move is not atomic. If a connection drops mid-operation a message can briefly exist in both folders.

faq.q: Does Claude work with Hostpoint email?
faq.a: Not on its own. Claude has no built-in Hostpoint connector. Pointing an MCP server such as MCPEmails at the mailbox over IMAP gives Claude read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize access to it, and the same connection then works from Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

faq.q: What are the Hostpoint IMAP and SMTP settings?
faq.a: IMAP is imap.mail.hostpoint.ch on port 993 with SSL. SMTP is asmtp.mail.hostpoint.ch on port 465 with SSL, or 587 with STARTTLS, with authentication required. The username is your full address and the password is the one you defined in the Control Panel. Both hosts were confirmed from a live TLS connection on the date shown on this page.

faq.q: Why is my Hostpoint password rejected in a mail client?
faq.a: Usually because it is the Hostpoint customer login rather than the mailbox password. IMAP checks the password defined for the individual address in the Control Panel. Set a new one there and use that exact value.

faq.q: Does Hostpoint need an app password?
faq.a: No. Hostpoint has no app-specific password scheme. The mailbox password authenticates both IMAP and SMTP.

faq.q: Is my Hostpoint mail stored on your servers?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from Hostpoint over IMAP for each request and handed to your AI client. Credentials are encrypted at rest and message bodies are not retained.
